lessons.title: Practice questions: capstone readiness
lessons.description: Seven to ten questions on capstone readiness, with an answer key.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. One sample question is written so the format is clear; the remaining
> questions are not written yet.

## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in Capstone Project, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. Your capstone shows one channel that clearly underperformed. What should the report do?
+ Say so, and explain what you would change and why
- Leave it out so the results look stronger
- Blame the budget and move on
= Honest reporting with a next step is the professional standard, and it is what the rubric rewards.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

lessons.title: Assignment: the complete digital marketing capstone
lessons.description: Produce the complete digital marketing capstone, marked out of 100.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. The structure, title and position of this lesson are final; the body
> is not written yet.

## The brief

The complete digital marketing capstone. What is being asked for, and the constraints it has to work inside.

## What to submit

The file, the format and anything that must be shown alongside it.

:::template Submission cover sheet
Name:
Brand:
Module: Capstone Project
Deliverable:
Time spent:
What I would do differently with more budget:
:::

## Marking rubric

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
- Correct use of the method taught in this module — 30 marks
- Quality and realism of the deliverable — 30 marks
- Clarity of presentation and reasoning — 20 marks

A pass is 50. Anything that invents data about a real company scores zero on realism.
